originalIdentity: Headless anthropomorphic graveyard assemblage: a broad warm brown soil mound body crowned by several gray rimmed tan gravestone tablets with spare vertical black inscription-like strokes and pointed dark iron fence finials. Dominant tall arched wrought-iron cemetery gate on front of torso, dark charcoal bars with muted brass horizontal braces and rivets. Broad gray slab-built shoulders, arms and massive stone fists, short two stone legs and three blocklike toes per foot. Ochre soil in large joints, sparse olive moss/grass at earth seams. Three distinct lit brass/bronze lanterns: one on screen-left low chest, two vertically staggered on screen-right shoulder/chest. Muted golden circular inset/band details on upper arms and wrists. No humanoid head, eyes, skull, banner, new rune or weapon.
symbolReview: Preserve the original grave gate architecture and simplified tomb inscriptions, the few ring/circle gold inset details on arm bands, and three amber lanterns. No independent heraldic shield or readable new wording occurs in source. Do not add generic glowing golem chest emblem, skull face, Christian cross badge or new faction symbol. Gate spear points and original small tablet stroke shapes are architecture/source marks, not replacement heraldry.
